lessonTitle: 47. Sections of a tetrahedron and a parallelepiped

stages.headline: A section is the polygon where a plane cuts a solid; the section of DABC through the midpoints of DA, DB, DC is a triangle similar to ABC with k = 1/2.
stages.headlineEnglish: A section is the polygon where a plane cuts a solid; the section of DABC through the midpoints of DA, DB, DC is a triangle similar to ABC with k = 1/2.

stages.headline: The diagonal section AA₁C₁C of a cube is a rectangle with sides a and a√2.

stages.headline: A section of a cube can be a triangle, quadrilateral, pentagon or hexagon; with 6 faces it never has more than 6 sides.
stages.headlineEnglish: A section of a cube can be a triangle, quadrilateral, pentagon or hexagon; with 6 faces it never has more than 6 sides.
